title: Lesson 3 Checkpoint — Must / Have To
description: Show what you learned about must / have to. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Must / Have To: Must = speaker obligation/rules | Have to = external rules

questions.question: Complete: ___ have to finish today.

questions.question: True or false: "You must wear a seatbelt." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.

questions.question: Choose the word that correctly completes the sentence: I ___ to finish today.
